# SKMEI.LB — Official SKMEI Watch Store in Lebanon

## About
SKMEI.LB is Lebanon's official authorized dealer of SKMEI watches. We sell 100% authentic SKMEI digital, analog, sports, smart, and luxury watches across all of Lebanon with free nationwide delivery and a 1-year warranty.

## Business Details
- **Name:** SKMEI.LB
- **Type:** Online watch store / Official authorized dealer
- **Country:** Lebanon

- **Email:** skmei.lb@gmail.com
- **Website:** https://www.skmeilb.com
- **Currency:** USD (cash on delivery available)
- **Delivery:** Free on orders over $50; $4 standard; 3–5 business days anywhere in Lebanon

## Products
SKMEI.LB offers over 100 models across five categories:
1. **Digital Watches** — LED display, water-resistant, stopwatch, alarm, dual-time
2. **Sports Watches** — Shock-resistant, 100M water resistance, compass, altimeter
3. **Smart Watches** — Heart rate, steps, sleep tracking, Bluetooth notifications
4. **Analog Watches** — Classic quartz movement, stainless steel, leather bands
5. **Luxury Collection** — Premium materials, sapphire glass, dress watches

Price range: $15 – $80 USD. All products include 1-year manufacturer warranty.
